coastal.title: Community representatives call for 'dedicated attention' to Sunshine Coast ferry route
coastal.description: The Town of Gibsons Ferry Advisory Committee is calling on B.C. Ferries, the B.C. Ferry Authority and the provincial government to work with the community on making the route more reliable and accessible. The committee released its 2026 Annual Community Position Paper, outlining six priority areas for the three bodies to consider as decisions are made about the route’s future.

kamloops.title: Okanagan wine producers brace for U.S. ban on Canadian alcohol imports
kamloops.description: B.C. wine producers are bracing for the latest blow to cross-border alcohol sales, with the United States set to ban most Canadian alcohol imports later this month.

prince-george.title: Proposed Indigenous cultural centre at risk of being flooded by Site E reservoir if project goes ahead
prince-george.description: A section of land on the banks of the Peace River in northeastern B.C. — sought by Duncan's First Nation for a cultural revitalization centre — could end up submerged under a B.C. Hydro reservoir if a proposed fourth dam moves forward.

all.title: Wildfires, permafrost thaw in Canada causing even more climate change, new study shows
all.description: These climate feedback loops, where climate change triggers more greenhouse gas emissions that in turn feed into even more climate change, could add 20 to 30 per cent more warming over current estimates for this century.
